name: stack_waits_for_returning
description: A seat coming back from the caretaker needs a window to be handed back (design 6.7), so a hollow does not stack while one of its seats is returning (contract-m8 §2). Two present seats, no towers, 200 lives (a setter). Seat 1 calls wave 2 during wave 1 and its Ready waits for seat 2, who is present and has not said it. Then seat 2 goes AWAY and comes BACK in one turn: it is returning, and although every present seat is Ready (seat 1, and seat 2 counts while the caretaker holds it), the stacked horn does not sound, as it would for a seat only away; a fresh Ready from seat 1 is refused NO_STACK (its Un-Ready taken). Wave 1 clears alone into a window, which hands seat 2 back (present) on its first tick.

steps.assert: scene.client(1).seat(1).ready and scene.refusals(1) == [] and scene.rows('WAVE', ['wave'], {'start': true}) == [[1]]
steps.msg: seat 1's call is taken and waits for seat 2

steps.assert: scene.seat_state(2) == 'returning' and not scene.client(1).can_stack(0) and scene.client(1).seat(1).ready
steps.msg: seat 2 is returning: no stacking until its window, seat 1 still Ready
past wave 1's last creep, no stacked horn: it waits for the hand-back
a Ready while a seat returns is refused NO_STACK, the Un-Ready taken

steps.assert: clear.size() == 1 and clear[0][1] == 1 and clear[0][2] == 0 and scene.seat_state(2) == 'present'
steps.msg: wave 1 cleared alone into a window, which handed seat 2 back
away and returning in one turn, present in the window's opening stage
